Calculate prediction intervals

Source: R/stats.R
pred_int.Rd

Calculates prediction intervals for each distribution-estimation result in `df`. Normal, Lognormal, and Nonparametric distributions are dispatched to the corresponding EnvStats prediction-interval function.

Usage

pred_int(
  df,
  method = "Bonferroni",
  n_mean = 1,
  k = 1,
  pi_type = "upper",
  conf_level = 0.95
)

Arguments

df

A data frame returned by [est_dist()] with `keep_data_object = TRUE`.

method

Character string specifying the method used to calculate a parametric prediction interval. The value is passed to [EnvStats::predIntNorm()] or [EnvStats::predIntLnorm()].

n_mean

Positive integer specifying the number of observations used to calculate each future mean or geometric mean. The default, `1`, calculates an interval for individual future observations.

k

Positive integer specifying the number of future observations or means the interval should contain.

pi_type

Character string specifying the interval type. Supported values are `"two-sided"`, `"upper"`, and `"lower"`.

conf_level

A scalar between 0 and 1 specifying the confidence level.

Value

A data frame containing the grouping columns from `df`, the estimated distribution, sample size, confidence level, and prediction limits:

  • `lpl`: lower prediction limit;

  • `upl`: upper prediction limit;

  • `sample_size`: number of observations used;

  • `conf_level`: confidence level.

Details

The input must be generated by [est_dist()] with `keep_data_object = TRUE`.

See also

[pred_int_sim()], [est_dist()], [EnvStats::predIntNorm()], [EnvStats::predIntLnorm()], [EnvStats::predIntNpar()]

Examples

# \donttest{
data("gw_data")

wells <- c("MW-1", "MW-2", "MW-3", "MW-4")
params <- c(
  "Sulfate, total",
  "Arsenic, dissolved",
  "Boron, dissolved"
)

background <- lubridate::ymd(
  c("2007-12-20", "2012-01-01"),
  tz = "UTC"
)

background_data <- gw_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    location_id %in% wells,
    param_name %in% params,
    sample_date >= background[1],
    sample_date <= background[2]
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    location_id,
    param_name,
    default_unit
  ) |>
  percent_lt() |>
  est_dist(keep_data_object = TRUE)
#> Error in est_dist(percent_lt(dplyr::group_by(dplyr::filter(gw_data, location_id %in%     wells, param_name %in% params, sample_date >= background[1],     sample_date <= background[2]), location_id, param_name, default_unit)),     keep_data_object = TRUE): could not find function "est_dist"

pred_int(
  background_data,
  pi_type = "upper",
  conf_level = 0.99
)
#> Error: object 'background_data' not found
# }
